title: Geometry and generation by global germs on a geometric strict-local base
statement: Let s be a geometric point of a scheme S [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-geometric-point], A its strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], K a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], and u:Spec K\to A. Put t=(A\to S)u and E=A\times_S Spec K [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then E is affine, all its points are closed, and all its residue fields are separably closed. For every abelian etale sheaf F on E [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and each point z of E, the canonical germ map F(E)\to F_{\bar z} is surjective, where \bar z is the geometric point given by the algebraic closure of the residue field of z.

proof.text: First apply the affine strict-local base theorem. Apply the proved ind-etale coordinate-ring theorem and the global-germ-generation theorem. Ind-etale algebras are weakly etale. The flat multiplication criterion over the field K makes Gamma(E,O_E) absolutely flat (WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.WeakDimension, Ring.AbsolutelyFlat.of_flat_lmul'). The absolute-flatness TFAE makes every prime maximal. Transport the closed-point statement from Spec Gamma(E,O_E) through the affine isomorphism. The residue-field separability theorem makes each prime residue field separable over K. Its algebra map from the separably closed K is bijective, hence this residue field is separably closed. Transport twice, using Spec.residueFieldIso and the residue-field map of the affine isomorphism. Retain the germ-generation conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem strictLocalBase_geometry
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsSepClosed K]
    (u : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s) :
    let E := pullback (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
      (u ≫ Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    IsAffine E ∧ (∀ e : E, IsClosed ({e} : Set E)) ∧
      (∀ e : E, IsSepClosed (E.residueField e)) ∧
      ∀ (F : Sheaf E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (e : E),
        Function.Surjective
          ((Scheme.pointSmallEtale (E.algClosurePoint e)).toPresheafFiber
            (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 E))
            (Over.homMk (E.algClosurePoint e) (Category.comp_id _)) F.obj)
